product.title: 6 Hour Shared Deep Sea Fishing in Key West

description.text: Cruise from Key West into deeper waters where you can fish for tuna, mahi-mahi, and kingfish—species you won’t see in coastal areas. The small group size allows for plenty of one-on-one coaching from the captain and mate, with tips on how to make the most of provided gear. That means the experience will be tailored to you, whether you’re a lifelong angler or fishing for the first time.Visit offshore areas frequented by deep-water fish Use provided gear and bait suited to local conditions and season Fishing permit included—no need to apply for one Improve your fishing skills with tips from loca Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
